paragraphs: Before the shift, inspect equipment and material conditions. Set the machine within the process window and monitor feed continuously. Measure dimensions and inspect appearance at scheduled intervals, making small adjustments when results exceed limits. During product changes, stop the machine, change the die, and align the center. At shift end, clear material, maintain the equipment, save data, and hand off work.
